content: Use the reference image as the exact character and outfit reference. Create a 15-second authentic real-life street vlog. It must look like genuine handheld camera footage, not AI-generated or cinematic. The woman naturally walks across the zebra crossing with her coffee. The camera follows her casually from a slightly high handheld angle, with small realistic operator movements and imperfect framing. She reaches the sidewalk, takes a sip of coffee and adjusts her sunglasses while continuing to walk. Halfway through, she suddenly notices something across the street. The camera naturally reacts a moment later and pans toward it. Reveal an unexpected but believable street moment: a vintage car has stopped in the middle of traffic and people nearby are reacting to it. She looks surprised and briefly looks toward the camera. Natural daylight, real skin texture, realistic hair movement, natural walking physics, authentic clothing movement, real camera exposure, subtle autofocus changes, natural motion blur, slight handheld shake, ordinary street ambience. Absolutely no face distortion, no identity change, no outfit change, no extra fingers, no warped hands, no object morphing, no flickering, no frame glitches, no unnatural body movement, no rubbery motion, no floating objects, no excessive camera shake, no slow motion, no CGI look, no cinematic over-processing, no beauty filter, no artificial smoothness, no text or watermark. The final result should feel like a random 15-second clip someone genuinely recorded during their normal day.

Revela un momento callejero inesperado pero creíble: un coche vintage se ha detenido en medio del tráfico y la gente cercana está reaccionando. Ella se muestra sorprendida y mira brevemente hacia la cámara.
